newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico forex association supports undervalued peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico forex association supports undervalued peso.

text.p: The head of Mexico's Association of Exchange Houses on Thursday said the peso's level of undervaluation was currrently sufficient, but he said it would need to weaken soon to remain competitive.

"From now on, the exchange rate should begin to weaken to preserve a margin of undervaluation and reflect the differences between the inflation of Mexico and its main trading partners," Hector Lagos Donde told Reuters.
He estimated the peso's margin of undervaluation against the dollar at around 10 percent, a level he said was vital to maintain to spur exports.
The head of the association, which groups 48 exchange houses, added that the government should act to push the peso down against the dollar before exports begin to suffer.
"I think it would be an error to begin to act only after exports start going down...you have to get ahead with these things," Lagos said.
